title.narrative: Uttarakhand Integrated and Resilient Urban Development Project

description.narrative:
The proposed Uttarakhand Integrated Urban Development Project (UIUDP) will support improvement of universal and equitable access to safe and affordable drinking water, and access to adequate and equitable sanitation and hygiene for all ending open defecation, in support of Uttarakhand Vision 2030.
UIUDP will support in: (i) improving water supply system and service in Dehradun, (ii) enhance integrated sanitation systems and drainage in Dehradun and Nainital, (iii) develop and implement computerized maintenance and management systems (CMMS) in Dehradun and Nainital, and (iv) strengthen institutional capacity and knowledge of project implementation units and project management units in Dehradun and Nainital.

Output: Institutional capacity and knowledge strengthened Indicator: At least 50 women gained professional experience through a certified stipend-based internship program at UUSDA implemented (2021 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: As of Dec 2025:
Without stipened, an internship programme was organised for female B.Tech students of Women's Institute of Technology, Dehradun, between 5 - 20 February 2025. A total of 64 students of B.Tech 2nd, 3rd and final year participated in the programme. All students received a certificate for their participation. Programme resulted in improved knowledge on each topic i.e. Government Policy and Programme on Water Supply and Sewerage; Water Supply System; Wastewater; Construction management; Testing and Quality Control; Tube well-based water supply system, and water-sensitive urban design; Use of Technology -SCADA/Automation/GIS, Environmental, Social and Gender Safeguard, covered during the programme. Practical exposure facilitated their learning. Overall internship programme was rated excellent, including technical and field visits. There was a recommendation from teachers to continue this type of programme for the benefit of the students.
Likely to be achieved by Q1/2026 as per approved timeframe of GESI-AP
Data Source: Pre- and post-internship questionnaires Actual value:

Output: Integrated and resilient sanitation systems and drainage established in Dehradun, Haldwani, and Nainital Indicator: 1 STP with 17 MLD capacity, and 5 prefabricated STPs each with a capacity of at least 20 kiloliters per day constructed, commissioned, and in operation in Nainital (2021 baseline: 1 STP with 10 MLD capacity that is not functioning properly) (OP 4.1.2) Progress/Status: As of Dec 2025:
Successive landslides induced by excessive rainfall at the proposed STP site in Russi Village in 2022 and 2023 rendered the site unsafe and a new site for STP has already been identified. But it is yet to be handed over to the EA by GoU. Upon approval from GoU, construction of the STP at the new site will entail hydraulic design/construction of additional sewer line, site investigation will have to be conducted afresh, which may delay completion of the works. The decision to relocate the STP was approved by the Competent Authority/High Power Committee on 5th June 2024. However, the NOC/ site handover from GB Pant Biotechnology Institute to the Uttarakhand Urban Sector Development Agency is still pending.
Data Source: UUSDA's quarterly project progress reports Actual value:

A brief report on market survey prepared DPR is under preparation and is planned to be completed by Q1/2026. The implementation of this package is targeted from Q1/2026 until November 2027, as per approved timeframe of GESI-AP.
